quote.quote: This application was not referred to an FDA advisory committee.
There has been no Advisory Committee convened for this drug.

no_adcom_quote.quote: This application was not referred to an FDA advisory committee. Although incobotulinumtoxinA is a new molecular entity, its mechanism of action is well-understood and comparable to that of onabotulinumtoxinA (Botox), which was approved under section 351 of the Public Health Service Act in 1991, and abobotulinumtoxinA (Dysport), which was approved under the same Act in April, 2009.

summary: No FDA advisory committee was convened for Xeomin (incobotulinumtoxinA, BLA125360). The Office Director memo states the application was not referred to an advisory committee because the molecule's mechanism of action was well-understood and comparable to already-approved botulinum toxin products (Botox, Dysport), a decision the Division made and the Office supported. The cross-discipline and medical reviews independently confirm 'Not Applicable' and 'no Advisory Committee convened,' so there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
